title: Spicy Japanese Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and spicy noodle soup made with Japanese noodles, vegetables, and a zesty sauce.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced carrots and mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the pickle juice and zesty sauce and stir to combine.
Add the Japanese noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions.
